prompt: I'm about to change how the flood-fill in our core crate works and I want to make sure I don't make it slower. How do I set up benchmarking for it in this repo?

assertions.text: Specifies harness = false for the [[bench]] target
Uses std::hint::black_box rather than the deprecated criterion::black_box
Benchmarks at a realistic (large) canvas size, not a toy input
Says to compare before/after via cargo bench and keep only gains above noise
Notes timing must come from an optimized build, not dev
